title: 혼합 형식 연습지 (스크립트 회귀용)
subtitle: 중3 영어 / 줄마다 번호·지원 범위 밖 문항

items.stem: 주어진 글 (A)에 이어질 내용을 순서에 맞게 배열한 것은?
items.passage:
(A) Jun wanted to grow tomatoes on the balcony of his apartment. He bought a packet of seeds and a long green pot at the market. He read the back of the packet (a) __slowly__ before he opened it at home.

(B) After two weeks, small leaves finally appeared in the pot. Jun moved it to a (b) __sunny__ corner of the balcony and gave it water every morning before he left for school.

(C) He filled the pot with soil and (c) __planted__ the seeds in a straight line. Then he waited patiently, but for many days he saw only dark soil and nothing else.

(D) In summer the plants gave six red tomatoes. Jun shared them with his neighbor, who (d) __refused__ them with a big smile and said they were very (e) __sweet__ and fresh.

items.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~⑤ 중 어법상 틀린 것은?
items.prompt_text: Our team ① __plays__ every Saturday at the park. The coach who ② __trains__ us ③ __bring__ cold water, and we ④ __share__ it with the other team after the game ⑤ __ends__.

items.stem: 주어진 표현을 모두 사용하여 우리말을 영어 한 문장으로 쓰시오.
items.given:
나는 숙제를 끝낸 뒤에 가족과 저녁을 먹었다.
my homework / after / with my family / I / ate dinner / finished / I
answer: I ate dinner with my family after I finished my homework.

items.stem: 품사를 참고하여 각 단어의 우리말 뜻을 쓰시오.
왼쪽 단어와 뜻이 가장 가까운 단어를 오른쪽에서 찾아 번호를 쓰시오.
왼쪽 단어에 알맞은 영어 뜻풀이를 찾아 기호를 쓰시오.
match_right: a person who helps students learn
a place where people read and borrow books
a thick cover that keeps you warm in bed

items.stem: 보기에서 알맞은 단어를 골라 빈칸에 쓰시오. 한 단어는 남는다.
items.passage:
Please ____ your hands with soap before you sit down for lunch.

My uncle wants to ____ a small wooden house near the lake.

It is hot in here, so could you ____ the window a little?

items.stem: 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?
items.passage: The soup was too ____ for me, so I added some cold water to my bowl.

items.stem: 윗글의 빈칸 (18)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?
items.passage: Our family waters the plants on the balcony every evening. My sister fills the can, and I pour the water slowly. During our trip nobody watered them, and the leaves turned (18) ____ within a week. Now we ask our neighbor to help when we are away.
